summary: The audit checks the introductory physics courses, MATH 51-53 or 61CM-63CM plus one more math course, PHYSICS 120, 130 and 170, six courses in one pathway (each for at least 3 units), PHYSICS 191 for WIM, and a capstone, 75 units in all. Every course must be letter graded with a C- or better, except the introductory courses offered only S/NC. Checked by hand: an individually designed pathway, the research-paper capstone proposal, waivers of PHYSICS 41 or 43 after the placement diagnostic, and petitions to substitute math or introductory physics courses. Honors is optional.

hEhXfYYx.why: Pathways Overview notes: "A course taken to satisfy a Core Program Requirement (above) cannot also count for the Pathway requirement. In general, no course can double-count for two different requirements of the Physics Major." Capstone: "This is the only instance in which a course can double-count for two different requirements." So PHYSICS 191 fills WIM and cannot also be a pathway elective; the Capstone block still shares, since its text lets the capstone paper be written in PHYSICS 191 and lets PHYSICS 100, 108 or 171 also count for a pathway.

pT6zUbrN.why: "In general, no course can double-count for two different requirements of the Physics Major." and, of the capstone course option, "This is the only instance in which a course can double-count for two different requirements." program.why: Grading: "All courses for the Physics major must be taken for a letter grade, and a grade of C- or better must be received for all units applied toward the major, with the following exceptions: a grade of S is acceptable for PHYSICS 41, 61, 61L, 71L (or 81L), and 89L (or 79L)." Those courses are offered only S/NC, which the letter-grade rule allows.
